Welcome to TeamCraft
Before you start, TeamCraft protects your messages on this phone. It takes about two minutes.
Your messages are locked
Only your own devices can read them. Not the server, not your IT department.
You get a recovery kit
A file with your personal key. It is the spare key to your messages, like the spare key to your home.
Keep it safe, don\'t lose it
If you ever lose all your devices, the kit is the only way back to your messages. Nobody can make you a new one.
Save your recovery kit
Save the kit and keep it where you keep important papers or passwords: in your password manager, in your files, or print it.
You started this before. For your safety this is a new key: a kit you saved earlier does not work. Delete it and save this one.
Recovery key
Save recovery kit
Save again
Saved. Keep the file safe, not only on this phone.
The kit could not be saved. Pick another place, or write the key down.
The kit is a file with your key, a QR code and what to do with it. It is made on this phone and never sent to the server.
Can\'t save a file? I wrote the key down on paper
Check your recovery kit
Make sure you really have it: look at your saved kit and type the group asked for below, or open the file.
Group %1$d of your key
That isn\'t group %1$d. Look at your saved recovery kit again.
Type group %1$d from your saved kit, or open the kit file.
That\'s right.
Show the key again
Open recovery kit…
This is your new recovery kit.
This file holds another recovery key, not the one just made. Pick the kit you just saved.
No recovery key was found in this file. Pick the recovery kit TeamCraft saved for you.
Keep your kit safe
Almost done. Remember these three things, then finish the setup.
Keep it somewhere safe
With your important papers, or in your password manager. Not only on this phone.
Never send it
Not by e-mail, not in a chat, not even in TeamCraft. Whoever has it can read your messages.
Nobody will ask you for it
Not TeamCraft, not your IT department. Anyone who asks wants to trick you.
Unlock your messages here
Your account already has a key. To read your messages on this phone, bring the key here. Choose how:
Use another device
Approve this phone on a computer or phone where you\'re signed in. The quickest way, and your history comes along.
Use my recovery kit
Open the kit file or type the key from it. For when no other device is at hand.
Ask my IT department
No other device and no kit? Your IT department can help.
Unlock with your recovery kit
Open the kit file you saved when you set up your first device. You can also type the key printed in it.
Recovery key or passphrase
The key from your recovery kit (8 groups of 4 characters), or your passphrase if you set one up before recovery kits existed.
Open your kit file, or type the key from it.
The recovery key was read from the file.

TeamCraft recovery kit
Server: %1$s · Made on %2$s
This is the key to your encrypted messages. If you lose all your devices, it is the only way to read your messages again.
Keep it safe
Print this page and keep it somewhere safe, or keep the file in your password manager.
Don\'t send it by e-mail or chat, and don\'t store it in TeamCraft.
Anyone who has this key and can sign in as you can read your messages.
When you need it

Only when you set up a device and none of your other devices is at hand: sign in to TeamCraft, choose “Open recovery kit…” and pick this file, or type the key. If another of your devices is at hand, link the new one from it instead.
If it is lost or someone else saw it
Make a new recovery kit in TeamCraft on a computer under Settings, Security & privacy. This kit then stops working.
TeamCraft and your IT department will never ask you for this key.
When the admins approve, you finish here. Meanwhile, save a new recovery kit: the admins saw your old key, so your account gets a new one.
Finish the recovery
Once two admins have approved, finish here. Keep your new kit safe:
Ask your IT department
Tell your IT department that you lost all your devices and your recovery kit. They can reset your account: you then start with new keys, and your old messages are lost.
If your organization set up recovery, your IT department may ask you for a code to get your messages back.
Show the code for my IT department
Your organization hasn\'t set up recovery for you. Your IT department can only reset your account.
